name: ChangePassword
receipt_order: replay -> revalidate current credential/revision -> command_receipt -> replace verifier -> increment security_revision -> audit -> commit -> invalidate prior sessions/autologin material
revision_effects: security_auth_credentials.security_revision increments exactly once on APPLIED; committed replay/NO_CHANGE increments nothing
post_commit_work: invalidate prior browser sessions and stale auto-login material according to the session/auto-login algorithms; no post-commit domain revision is fabricated
rules: does not modify backup recovery material
old/new password and verifier excluded from audit/diagnostics
